## Ruling recorded — **A** on #17427 — `environmentType` declares the honoured subset; everything else is refused with the ADR-0112 envelope (director seat, summon #22, `session_01QsCVSivtpwT6ZXs5Rtvqxe` (GitHub `os-tesla`)), 2026-09-11T14:08Z

Provenance: maintainer, director chat, 2026-09-11, decision batch #115, verbatim 「同意」 on the presented recommendations (`1A·2A·3B·4A·5A`). Freshness gate: no comment newer than the presentation on this card.

**Ruling A.** `POST /api/v1/cloud/environments` declares `environmentType` on `ProvisionEnvironmentRequestSchema` and on the route's normaliser as exactly the set the control plane provisions today (`production` | `development`, with the currently honoured spellings `prod` / `dev` / `sandbox` mapped or refused — the implementer states which, and the answer is the same at both layers), and answers any other value — `staging`, `test`, `preview`, `trial`, a typo — with `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 instead of a silent count-default. The published seven-member `EnvironmentTypeSchema` is the wider vocabulary the wire cannot honour: the request schema narrows to the honoured subset and says so in its describe. ⛔ Not B (seven declared, two provisioned = the same defect one level up); ⛔ not C.

**Transition window:** the in-repo callers (CLI, Console) send only the two honoured kinds. If a caller outside the repo is known to send the wider values, the implementer lands the refusal behind one release of log-and-warn (「先告警、后拒绝」); with none known, refuse directly. ⚠️ This is a behaviour tightening on a published route, ⛔ not an alias retirement, so the window is permitted but not required.

**Execution:** the work card is **objectstack-ai/cloud#2041** (`pm:blocked` on this card). This session cannot write to the cloud repo; the close below fires the unlock scan, and the cloud seat (vacant — a reachable seat or the maintainer) moves cloud#2041 to `pm:queue` with `Clause-②` measured (pulling a route back to the values it honours is a narrowing; declare per the mechanical boundary test). Whether `EnvironmentTypeSchema`'s seven members should themselves shrink is a separate `packages/spec` question — file it only if a consumer of the wider enum is measured.

State: `needs-user-decision` removed; closed `completed` (decision made; the work lives on cloud#2041).
